north_arrow_measurement.method: sub-pixel ink fit of the N-S stroke (measure-S/code/linefit.py)
north_arrow_measurement.description: Cross-hair rose under the letter N: a ring with a filled centre and a cross whose N-S stroke runs from y 94.5 to 131.5; the stroke is fitted on its two arms outside the ring, the tail at the south tip and the tip at the north tip. The E-W stroke fits at page azimuth 89.978 deg, square to the N-S stroke within 0.04 deg.

rendering_check.note: Native digital drawing rasterised by the journal. Survey-grid lines drawn on the plan: vertical Ea1 line 0.000 and Ia1 line 0.005 deg (half-difference 0.002); horizontal lines at y 136 89.850 and y 372 89.984 deg (half-difference 0.067; the y-136 line is partly merged with the band edge). Figure frame half-differences 0.000 (left-right) and 0.000 (top-bottom). We use 0.1 deg, the value for a native digital drawing, which exceeds all of these.

systems.description: The four faces of the near-square fortification, outer and inner edges of the drafted band. North and south faces run within about 1 deg of the plan's E-W, the west and east faces within about 0.5 deg of its N-S; the band is drawn turned slightly clockwise relative to the survey-grid lines and the north symbol, which are themselves aligned with the page to within 0.02 deg.

main_system_reason: The fortification is the only Harappan structure drawn at measurable length on the plan and encloses the principal walled part of the town; it is the system of largest total length.
notes: The band is the excavators' 'Plan of fortification': a reconstruction joining the excavated segments of the mud-brick wall (hatched, in trenches Do14, Ek13, Bv6, Hh6, Hc2, Fp1 and others) by straight faces drawn with dashed outlines, so the faces are drafted, not traced along exposed masonry over their whole length. Inside the fortification the plan draws trenches and labels only ('Structures Ph. I', 'Centre Square', 'Brick paved floor'), with no wall lines. Outside it, trench Ik7 ('Str. remains') holds wall lines about 20 px (9 m) long a few pixels from the trench edges; they were not measured, since their picking error alone exceeds 4 deg. The arrow term (2.4 deg, set by the 37-px north stroke and a one-pixel endpoint floor) dominates every line's sigma. Survey-grid lines Ea1, Fa1, Ia1 and grid pegs are drawn but no grid values or datum are given. In the context text of IAR 1989-90 (p. 20) we read a statement about the orientation of structures in the 1989-90 trenches G and H of the Gujarat State excavation; it played no part in these measurements.
